notes.title: New update!
New update!
Client Update
notes.notes:
With March 5th client update we finally solved level progress issues. Entrance puzzle is not considered as a level, so level completion counter starts with second puzzle and achievements will work as expected.
Also this update introduces game localization to following languages (selectable in Steam game properties):

English
German
Spanish
French
Simplified Chinese
Italian
Korean
Dutch
Portuguese
Russian

P.S. We are having some issues with Hindi font and localization so I'd greatly appreciate if someone from native speakers contact me for free beta testing.
